headline: Gold hits over 3-month high ahead of US inflation data and Fed chair speech
summary: Gold moved higher to a more than three-month high, taking its cues primarily from a softer US dollar. Traders are awaiting US inflation data and a speech by the Federal Reserve chair.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value and is priced in US dollars, so it tends to respond to dollar moves and to expectations for US inflation and interest rates set by the Federal Reserve.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold rose to a three-month high as the US dollar softened.
